entries.name: geom.edge.create
entries.description: Create an edge. The nodes can either be specified by their IDs or as node pointers. The nodes must already exist.

entries.name: geom.edge.delete
entries.description: Delete an edge. Any object (e.g., a polygon) connected to the edge is also deleted.

entries.name: geom.edge.dir
entries.description: Get the edge direction. The edge direction is defined the vector from node 1 to node 2. Its magnitude is the length from node 1 to node 2.

entries.name: geom.edge.dir.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the edge direction. The edge direction is defined from node 1 to node 2.

entries.name: geom.edge.dir.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of the edge direction. The edge direction is defined from node 1 to node 2.

entries.name: geom.edge.dir.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of the edge direction. The edge direction is defined from node 1 to node 2.

entries.name: geom.edge.extra
entries.description: Get/set edge extra variable.

entries.name: geom.edge.find
entries.description: Find an edge.

entries.name: geom.edge.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to edge e in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: geom.edge.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the edge in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: geom.edge.id
entries.description: Get the edge ID.

entries.name: geom.edge.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the edge and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: geom.edge.list
entries.description: Get the edge list of a geometry set. Use the loop foreach construct to iterate through the list.

entries.name: geom.edge.near
entries.description: Find the closest edge to a point. If f is specified, then the search radius is limited.

entries.name: geom.edge.next.edge
entries.description: Get the next edge connected to the node with local index i within the source edge e. This can be used to iterate through all edges connected to a node using the geom.edge.next.index function.

entries.name: geom.edge.next.index
entries.description: Get local index ir of a point within the next edge attached to this point (note: the same point has local index i within the source edge e).

entries.name: geom.edge.node
entries.description: Get an edge node.

entries.name: geom.edge.node.pos
entries.description: Get/set the node position.

entries.name: geom.edge.node.pos.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the node position.

entries.name: geom.edge.node.pos.y
entries.description: Get/set the y-component of the node position.

entries.name: geom.edge.node.pos.z
entries.description: Get/set the z-component of the node position.

entries.name: geom.edge.polys
entries.description: Get the list of polygons that use the edge.

entries.name: geom.edge.pos
entries.description: Get the edge position. The edge position is the center of the edge.

entries.name: geom.edge.pos.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the edge position. The edge position is the center of the edge.

entries.name: geom.edge.pos.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of the edge position. The edge position is the center of the edge.

entries.name: geom.edge.pos.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of the edge position. The edge position is the center of the edge.

entries.name: geom.edge.remove
entries.description: Delete an edge. Any object (e.g., a polygon) connected to the edge is also deleted.

entries.name: geom.edge.start.index
entries.description: Get local index i of edge e within the first polygon attached to the edge. This can be used to iterate through all polygons attached to an edge using the geom.edge.start.poly, geom.poly.next.poly and geom.poly.next.index functions.

entries.name: geom.edge.start.poly
entries.description: Get the first polygon attached to edge e. This is used to iterate through all polygons attached to an edge using the geom.edge.start.index, geom.poly.next.poly and geom.poly.next.index functions.

entries.name: geom.edge.typeid
entries.description: Get the edge type number. The type ID can be used to uniquely identify edge FISH pointers, and distinguish them from any other type of FISH pointer.

entries.name: geom.node.create
entries.description: Create a node. The node is located at v.

entries.name: geom.node.delete
entries.description: Delete a node. All dependent objects connected to the node are deleted.

entries.name: geom.node.edges
entries.description: Get the list of edges connected to the node.

entries.name: geom.node.extra
entries.description: Get/set node extra variable.

entries.name: geom.node.find
entries.description: Find a node.

entries.name: geom.node.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to node n in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: geom.node.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the node in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: geom.node.id
entries.description: Get the node ID.

entries.name: geom.node.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the node and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: geom.node.list
entries.description: Get the node list of a geometry set. Use the loop foreach construct to iterate through the list.

entries.name: geom.node.near
entries.description: Find the closest node to a point. If f is specified, then the search radius is limited.

entries.name: geom.node.polys
entries.description: Get the list of polygons that use the node.

entries.name: geom.node.pos
entries.description: Get/set the node position.

entries.name: geom.node.pos.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the node position.

entries.name: geom.node.pos.y
entries.description: Get/set the y-component of the node position.

entries.name: geom.node.pos.z
entries.description: Get/set the z-component of the node position.

entries.name: geom.node.remove
entries.description: Delete a node. All dependent objects connected to the node are deleted.

entries.name: geom.node.start.edge
entries.description: Get the first edge connected to a node. This can be used to iterate through all edges attached to a node with the geom.node.start.index, geom.edge.next.edge and geom.edge.next.index functions.

entries.name: geom.node.start.index
entries.description: Get local index i of point n within the first edge attached to the point. This can be used to iterate through all edges attached to a node with the geom.node.start.edge, geom.edge.next.edge and geom.edge.next.index functions.

entries.name: geom.node.typeid
entries.description: Get the node type number. The type ID can be used to uniquely identify node FISH pointers, and distinguish them from any other type of FISH pointer.

entries.name: geom.poly.add.edge
entries.description: Add an edge to a polygon. The edges must be in order so that each edge connects via a node to the edge before it. An error results if this is not true.

entries.name: geom.poly.add.node
entries.description: Add an edge via a node addition.

entries.name: geom.poly.area
entries.description: Get the polygon area. The polygon must be valid.

entries.name: geom.poly.check
entries.description: Get the validity status. A polygon is valid if: 1) it has at least 3 edges; 2) the edges are all connected; and 3) the polygon is closed.

entries.name: geom.poly.close
entries.description: Close a polygon. An edge is created between the first node of the first edge and the last node of the last edge. If an edge already exists between the nodes, then the preexisting edge will be used by the polygon and returned.

entries.name: geom.poly.create
entries.description: Create a polygon. The newly created polygon has no edges, so is in an invalid state. Edges may be added with geom.poly.add.edge or geom.poly.add.node before the polygon is in a valid state.

entries.name: geom.poly.delete
entries.description: Delete a polygon. The polygon must belong to g.

entries.name: geom.poly.edge
entries.description: Get a polygon edge. A null pointer may be returned.

entries.name: geom.poly.extra
entries.description: Get/set polygon extra variable.

entries.name: geom.poly.find
entries.description: Find a polygon.

entries.name: geom.poly.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to polygon p in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: geom.poly.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the polygon in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: geom.poly.id
entries.description: Get the polygon ID.

entries.name: geom.poly.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the polygon and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: geom.poly.list
entries.description: Get the polygon list of a geometry set. Use the loop foreach construct to iterate through the list.

entries.name: geom.poly.near
entries.description: Find the closest polygon to a point. If f is specified, then the search radius is limited.

entries.name: geom.poly.near.map
entries.description: Finds all polygons in the geometry set with centroids within f distance to position v, and returns all of them in a map.

entries.name: geom.poly.next.index
entries.description: Get local index ir of an edge within the next polygon attached to this edge (note: the same edge has local index i within the source polygon p).

entries.name: geom.poly.next.poly
entries.description: Get the next polygon connected to the edge with local index i within the source polygon p. This can be used to iterate through all polygons connected to an edge using the geom.poly.next.index function.

entries.name: geom.poly.node
entries.description: Get a node.

entries.name: geom.poly.normal
entries.description: Get the polygon normal. If not planar, this is the average of each vertex

entries.name: geom.poly.normal.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the polygon normal. If not planar, this is the average of each vertex

entries.name: geom.poly.normal.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of the polygon normal. If not planar, this is the average of each vertex

entries.name: geom.poly.normal.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of the polygon normal. If not planar, this is the average of each vertex

entries.name: geom.poly.pos
entries.description: Get the polygon position.

entries.name: geom.poly.pos.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the polygon position.

entries.name: geom.poly.pos.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of the polygon position.

entries.name: geom.poly.pos.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of the polygon position.

entries.name: geom.poly.remove
entries.description: Delete a polygon. The polygon must belong to g.

entries.name: geom.poly.size
entries.description: Get the number of edges.

entries.name: geom.poly.typeid
entries.description: Get the polygon type number. The type ID can be used to uniquely identify polygon FISH pointers, and distinguish them from any other type of FISH pointer.

entries.name: geom.set.closest
entries.description: Get closest node coordinate vector from the position supplied.

entries.name: geom.set.create
entries.description: Create a geometry set. One can optionally specify a unique ID along with the required geometry set name.

entries.name: geom.set.delete
entries.description: Delete a geometry set. All associated edges/nodes are deleted.

entries.name: geom.set.edge.maxid
entries.description: Get the maximum edge ID.

entries.name: geom.set.edge.num
entries.description: Get the number of edges.

entries.name: geom.set.find
entries.description: Find a geometry set.

entries.name: geom.set.id
entries.description: Get the geometry set ID.

entries.name: geom.set.list
entries.description: Get the global geometry set list. Use the loop foreach construct to iterate through the list.

entries.name: geom.set.maxid
entries.description: Get the maximum geometry set ID.

entries.name: geom.set.name
entries.description: Get the geometry set name.

entries.name: geom.set.node.maxid
entries.description: Get the maximum node ID.

entries.name: geom.set.node.num
entries.description: Get/set the number of nodes.

entries.name: geom.set.num
entries.description: Get the number of geometry sets.

entries.name: geom.set.poly.closest
entries.description: Get closest node coordinate vector on polygons from the position supplied.

entries.name: geom.set.poly.maxid
entries.description: Get the maximum polygon ID.

entries.name: geom.set.poly.num
entries.description: Get the number of polygons.

entries.name: geom.set.raydist
entries.description: Get the distance from a point to the set along a ray.

entries.name: geom.set.remove
entries.description: Delete a geometry set. All associated edges/nodes are deleted.

entries.name: geom.set.typeid
entries.description: Get the geometry set type number. The type ID can be used to uniquely identify geometry set FISH pointers, and distinguish them from any other type of FISH pointer.
